name: BuildHub Platform
description: build a mobile app (iOS and Android compatible), aimed at car enthusiasts. The main features should be a) travel as a group with everyone's real time locations on a map, b) perform a walkie-talkie kind of operation at the click of a button (without interfering with the audio being played by the user's device), c) have a record of statistics from the group drive with a leaderboard for things such as top speed or safest driving within the group, d) individual accounts should contain the username and profile photo with the option to choose what bike/car they drive, e) alerts about police/obstructions/road closures/lane closures/average and instant speed cameras/traffic density/traffic lights.

targetStack.frontend: React 18, Redux Toolkit, React-Router v6, CSS System
targetStack.external: Stripe Payments, AWS S3 Media Storage, SendGrid Email

businessLayer.title: Identity Verification & Credential Hardening
businessLayer.desc: Email serves as unique account handle; passwords salted with bcrypt factor 10. Sessions governed by stateless HMAC-SHA256 JWT tokens.

businessLayer.title: State Transition & Domain Integrity Invariant
businessLayer.desc: Mutations require strict ownership assertion (req.user.id matches resource.user). State transitions adhere to finite state machine rules.

businessLayer.title: Idempotency & Concurrent Conflict Resolution
businessLayer.desc: Financial and booking operations require client-generated idempotency keys. Double-booking or duplicate actions are rejected with HTTP 400/409.

businessLayer.title: Cascading Account Deletion Policy
businessLayer.desc: User account deletion triggers atomic cascade purging user credentials, profiles, authored content, and associated subdocuments.

functionalLayer.desc: Register account credentials and receive JWT bearer token
Authenticate email/password and obtain session token
Query active domain catalog with filter and cursor pagination
Fetch single resource entity by ID
Initiate state action / booking / payment transaction
Cascading purge of account and associated records

diagrams.sequenceAuth:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as Client User
    participant Router as Express API Router
    participant Auth as Auth Middleware
    participant Service as Domain Service
    participant DB as Persistent Database

    User->>Router: POST /api/v1/auth/login { email, password }
    Router->>Auth: Ingest credentials
    Auth->>DB: UserAccount.findOne({ email })
    alt Credentials Valid
        DB-->>Auth: User Record Found
        Auth->>Auth: Verify bcrypt hash & generate JWT
        Auth-->>User: 200 OK { token, user }
    else Invalid Credentials
        DB-->>Auth: null or mismatch
        Auth-->>User: 400 Bad Request { msg: "Invalid credentials" }
    end

    Note over User, DB: Subsequent Authenticated Request
    User->>Router: POST /api/v1/resources (Header: Bearer Token)
    Router->>Auth: Verify JWT signature
    Auth-->>Router: req.user = { id: "user_uuid" }
    Router->>Service: Create Resource Entity
    Service->>DB: DomainResource.save()
    DB-->>Service: Saved Record
    Service-->>User: 201 Created { resource }

stories.title: User Registration & Credential Hashing
stories.statement: As a new user, I want to create an account with my email and password, so that I can establish an authenticated identity.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Successful registration
  Given an email and password of at least 8 characters
  When the user submits registration
  Then the system hashes the password with bcrypt salt factor 10
  And returns a signed JWT bearer token.

Scenario: Duplicate email rejection
  Given an existing registered email
  When registration is attempted with the same email
  Then HTTP 400 is returned with "User already exists".

stories.title: Secure User Login
stories.statement: As a registered user, I want to log in with my credentials, so that I can access my protected workspace.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Valid credentials login
  Given valid email and password
  When submitted
  Then HTTP 200 with JWT is returned.

stories.title: Persistent Session Recovery
stories.statement: As an authenticated user, I want my session to remain active upon browser refresh, so that I do not need to re-login repeatedly.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Session hydration on refresh
  Given a stored JWT token in client storage
  When the client initializes
  Then GET /api/v1/auth/me is called and state is populated.

stories.title: Resource Catalog Browsing with Keyset Pagination
stories.statement: As a user, I want to browse active domain items with filtering and cursor pagination, so that I can explore offerings smoothly.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Keyset query execution
  Given limit parameter of 20
  When resources are queried
  Then up to 20 items are returned along with nextCursor.

stories.title: Create and Publish Domain Resource
stories.statement: As an authorized user, I want to create and publish a domain resource, so that other users can discover it.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Resource publishing
  Given required title and description attributes
  When submitted with JWT
  Then record is created in database with owner_id set to req.user.id.

stories.title: Author-Only Resource Deletion
stories.statement: As a resource creator, I want to delete my own items, so that I can remove obsolete listings.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Authorized deletion
  Given user owns resource R
  When DELETE request is submitted
  Then resource R is removed.

Scenario: Unauthorized deletion attempt
  Given user B does not own resource R
  When user B attempts DELETE
  Then HTTP 401 Unauthorized is returned.

stories.title: Execute Domain Transaction / Booking
stories.statement: As a client, I want to execute a transaction on a selected resource, so that my reservation or order is confirmed.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Atomic reservation execution
  Given resource R is available
  When transaction is submitted
  Then state transitions to RESERVED with immutable audit log.

stories.title: Cascading Account Purge & GDPR Erasure
stories.statement: As a registered user, I want to permanently delete my account, so that all my personal data and records are eradicated.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Complete cascade delete
  When user confirms account deletion
  Then profile, credentials, resources, and sessions are purged.

roadmap.title: Dual-Token Refresh Architecture & Rate Limiting
roadmap.desc: Implement 15-minute access tokens with 7-day rotated HttpOnly refresh tokens in Redis. Add express-rate-limit.

roadmap.title: Keyset / Cursor-Based Query Pagination
roadmap.desc: Enforce keyset pagination with cursor and limit across all catalog endpoints to eliminate unbounded query heap exhaustion.

roadmap.title: WebSockets Real-Time Push Notification Engine
roadmap.desc: Integrate Socket.io cluster with Redis pub/sub adapter for instant status and transaction push alerts.

roadmap.title: Distributed Redis Cache & Full-Text Search
roadmap.desc: Deploy Redis cluster for resource caching and integrate Elasticsearch / Atlas Search for fuzzy queries.

roadmap.title: Microservices Decomposition & Apache Kafka Event Log
roadmap.desc: Decompose monolithic services into Auth, Resource, and Transaction microservices communicating via an Apache Kafka distributed bus.
